summary: Alpha Modus Holdings filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on October 6, 2026 it fully satisfied all outstanding obligations under its Secured Pre-Paid Purchase #1 dated June 29, 2026 with Streeterville Capital, LLC. Having determined the facility was no longer needed, the Company terminated the related Securities Purchase Agreement under Section 7. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. This is a routine financing-payoff disclosure, not a special situation; watch for dilution overhang removal and any future financing needs.
